prompt: Every hour on the hour until 18:00, have arm1 inspect box1 on shelf_a with camera_top.
why: A time trigger: "every hour on the hour" starts a run at a time, which is a `when` clause that the mission layer gets in a later iteration (0041 M6). A run every 60 minutes after the last one (a wait inside the task) is a different request, `m10`.
